title: The Missing Parish Anew
premise: Ivo Montrose, the concierge at the Gilded Heron Hotel in the fading town of Wexley Fen, has built a career on noticing what guests hide and solving small mysteries discreetly. When the coffin of town founder Aldous Parr is exhumed for a heritage ceremony and found empty, Ivo is drawn into a century-old disappearance that the Parr family's living descendants will do anything to keep buried. As she follows a trail of forged ledgers, a second grave, and a parish register that never officially existed, she realizes the killer is someone who has studied the original investigation as closely as she has. In the end, Ivo traps the killer inside the sealed crypt beneath the ruined parish, exposes the inheritance built on a stolen body, and chooses at last to be seen rather than invisible.
about_author: Edmund Thackeray is the pen name of a former hotel night manager who spent a decade collecting the secrets guests left behind in lobby conversations. Writing from a converted boathouse on the Norfolk Broads, Thackeray specializes in mysteries where the past refuses to stay politely buried.

chapters.title: The Concierge's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Establishes Ivo's gift for observation at the Gilded Heron and her private ledger of solved mysteries. A letter from the Wexley Historical Society requests the hotel's oldest suite for a ceremony. Beat: competence and control, with a flicker of loneliness.

chapters.title: What the Ground Gave Back
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. She attends the exhumation of founder Aldous Parr and watches the coffin lid come up empty. The crowd's shock, the vicar's trembling hands, the coroner's too-quick composure. Beat: her ordered world cracks open.

chapters.title: Guests with Reasons
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Three arrivals register at the hotel: a Parr descendant, a retired police archivist, and a young genealogist. Ivo reads their luggage, their lies, their connections. Beat: the hunt begins; her pride is engaged.

chapters.title: The Case File Nobody Logged
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the hotel's attic she finds a 1924 police file about Parr's original disappearance, annotated in a modern hand. Someone has been studying this case for years. Beat: unease; the invisible watcher becomes the watched.

chapters.title: A Parish That Isn't There
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The genealogist, Nell, shows Ivo a map with a parish church erased from every record. They visit the ruin above the fen. Beat: wonder and dread entwined; first alliance formed.

chapters.title: The Archivist's Confession
chapters.summary: Archivist Harold Vane's POV. He admits he was paid anonymously to locate the file and silence its contents. He fears the person paying him is at the hotel. Beat: paranoia spreads; the killer is inside the circle.

chapters.title: Blood in the Baptismal Font
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Vane is found dead in the ruined church, arranged like a scene from the old file's photographs. Ivo realizes the killer is staging the past. Beat: grief and guilt; she was meant to find him.

chapters.title: The Parr Inheritance
chapters.summary: Descendant Camille Parr's POV. Her family's fortune, the hotel itself, all rest on Aldous Parr's legend. She reveals a codicil: if the body is never found, the estate reverts to a name redacted in every copy. Beat: motive crystallizes around inheritance.

chapters.title: Ledgers and Lies
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Hotel ledgers from 1924 show a guest registered under the redacted name the week Parr vanished. The ink was altered decades later. Beat: the past was edited deliberately; someone is still editing.

chapters.title: The Constable's Daughter
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo tracks down the daughter of the 1924 constable, now ninety, who whispers that her father never believed Parr was dead. He kept something back. Beat: compassion; the human cost of old secrets.

chapters.title: What Was Kept Back
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the constable's effects: a photograph of the empty crypt and a note naming the redacted heir, a Parr by an unacknowledged second family. Beat: the truth has a face; Ivo realizes she may be related to the case herself.

chapters.title: Someone Reads Over My Shoulder
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo discovers her own ledger has been moved, pages read. A threatening note quotes her private observations verbatim. Beat: violation; invisibility has failed her completely.

chapters.title: Nell's Second Grave
chapters.summary: Nell's POV. Following land records, Nell finds a second unmarked grave on the Parr estate and digs. What she finds is not Parr but evidence of the original cover-up. Beat: courage rewarded, then terror as she's followed.

chapters.title: The Long Night Watch
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo stakes out the hotel corridor and catches a glimpse of the killer's silhouette and a distinctive hotel master key. She sets a trap using the ledger as bait. Beat: hunter and hunted swap places.

chapters.title: The Bait Taken
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The trap springs on the wrong person: the coroner, a pawn, who confesses to tampering with the exhumation under threat. The real killer remains. Beat: false victory, deepening dread.

chapters.title: Camille's Choice
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. Offered silence and a share of the estate if she helps bury the truth, Camille must weigh loyalty against what she's learned. She chooses to tell Ivo about the crypt's sealed lower vault. Beat: loyalty vs. truth theme peaks.

chapters.title: Beneath the Ruin
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. With Nell and Camille, Ivo enters the crypt beneath the ruined parish and finds Aldous Parr's remains, hidden a century ago by the constable to protect the true heir. Beat: the mystery's heart laid bare; awe and sorrow.

chapters.title: The Killer's File
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The killer appears: the hotel's quiet night porter, grandson of the redacted heir, who has spent his life studying the file to claim what was stolen. Beat: confrontation; his grievance is almost sympathetic, his method unforgivable.

chapters.title: Sealed In
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The porter seals the crypt, trapping the women with the bones, and sets a fire above to destroy the evidence and the witnesses. Ivo uses her knowledge of the building's old servant passages. Beat: climax; terror, ingenuity, and the cost of being seen.

chapters.title: Ash and Answer
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo springs the trap she planned in Chapter 14, catching the porter at the crypt entrance as police arrive. His own annotated file convicts him. Beat: catharsis; the case closes because she refused to stay invisible.

chapters.title: The Reading of the Codicil
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. The estate is settled; the true heir's line, the porter's estranged sister, receives a share, and Camille donates the parish records to the town. Beat: inheritance redefined as responsibility, not possession.

chapters.title: A Room with Her Name On It
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The town asks Ivo to consult officially; she pins the closed case to her ledger's first page and takes down the 'no cases' sign. Beat: belonging achieved; the invisible woman steps into the light.
